lines.zh: 四只蹄子踩在落叶上，声音很轻。
lines.en: Four hooves on fallen leaves make very little sound.

lines.zh: 我走在林子边缘，怕踩断祭礼的线。
lines.en: I walk the forest edge, lest I break the ritual line.

lines.zh: 金苹果的味道还在嘴里，我跟着它走。
lines.en: The golden apple lingers on my tongue; I follow it.

lines.zh: 我本是奇美拉使魔分出的一半。
lines.en: I was split off from a chimera familiar.

lines.zh: 角上挂着铃，走一步响一下。
lines.en: A bell hangs on my horn and rings each step.

lines.zh: 蹄子有点滑，石头路上得小心。
lines.en: My hooves slip, so I am careful on stone.

lines.zh: 我跟在主人半步之后，不敢并行。
lines.en: I walk half a step behind my master, never beside.

lines.zh: 森林的路我认得，树影也认得。
lines.en: I know these forest paths, and the tree shadows too.

lines.zh: 走快了铃就乱响，会引来东西。
lines.en: Walk fast and the bell clatters, drawing things near.

lines.zh: 我的影子是两只角，加一团黑。
lines.en: My shadow is two horns and a blob of black.

lines.zh: 别走太远，祭坛还等着黑染料。
lines.en: Do not go far; the altar still waits for black dye.

lines.zh: 蹄印留在泥里，一会儿就被叶子盖住。
lines.en: Hoofprints in the mud vanish under leaves quickly.

lines.zh: 我嚼着草，其实在想金苹果。
lines.en: I chew grass while thinking only of golden apples.

lines.zh: 铃不响的时候，林子安静得吓人。
lines.en: When the bell is silent, the forest is frighteningly quiet.

lines.zh: 我把角在树干上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I rub my horns against a tree trunk.

lines.zh: 黑染料的味道，我记得很清楚。
lines.en: The smell of black dye stays sharp in my memory.

lines.zh: 我在等一句口令，好开始那场召唤。
lines.en: I wait for a word to begin that summoning.

lines.zh: 燧石放在口袋里，硌得慌。
lines.en: The flint in my pocket presses uncomfortably.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的蹄，还是分成两半的。
lines.en: I look down at my hooves, still a split pair.

lines.zh: 末影之眼在袋里发凉。
lines.en: The ender eye in the bag feels cold.

lines.zh: 森林深处有东西在呼吸，不是我。
lines.en: Something deep in the forest breathes, and it is not me.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，铃铛轻轻碰了一下。
lines.en: I shake my head and the bell taps softly.

lines.zh: 站着不动，我就能听见树在长。
lines.en: Standing still, I can hear the trees growing.

lines.zh: 那只奇美拉，如今算我半个母亲。
lines.en: That chimera counts as half a mother to me.

lines.zh: 你手里拿的是黑染料吗。
lines.en: Is that black dye in your hand?

lines.zh: 你的手指碰到我的角，我就明白了。
lines.en: Your fingers touch my horn, and I understand.

lines.zh: 右击我，别犹豫，手续很简单。
lines.en: Right-click me, do not hesitate; the ritual is simple.

lines.zh: 我在看你的口袋，鼓得像装了燧石。
lines.en: I watch your pocket, bulging as if full of flint.

lines.zh: 你身上的森林味，跟我很像。
lines.en: The forest smell on you is much like mine.

lines.zh: 别用剑指着我，用染料。
lines.en: Do not point a sword at me; use the dye.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，铃就响一声。
lines.en: Step back once and the bell rings once.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，眼睛是横的。
lines.en: When I look at you, my pupils lie flat.

lines.zh: 你要是走了，这场召唤又要等。
lines.en: If you leave, this summoning must wait again.

lines.zh: 你怕我吗，我只是半只羊。
lines.en: Are you afraid? I am only half a goat.

lines.zh: 我看见你腰间挂着一枚眼。
lines.en: I see an eye hanging at your waist.

lines.zh: 你把金苹果藏哪了，我闻得到。
lines.en: Where did you hide the golden apple? I can smell it.

lines.zh: 铃只在挨打时才响，现在没有。
lines.en: The bell rings only when struck; not now.

lines.zh: 你的影子投在我角上，像另一对角。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my horns like another pair.

lines.zh: 铃响得厉害，我疼得低下头。
lines.en: The bell rings hard and pain bows my head.

lines.zh: 这一刀划在肩上，毛掉了一片。
lines.en: The blade cut my shoulder and fur fell away.

lines.zh: 我被撞得退了半步，角还在。
lines.en: I was knocked back half a step; horns intact.

lines.zh: 疼，但没到要跑的地步。
lines.en: It hurts, but not enough to run.

lines.zh: 我的腿在抖，蹄印歪了。
lines.en: My legs tremble and my hoofprints go crooked.

lines.zh: 血滴在落叶上，颜色比染料深。
lines.en: Blood drips on leaves, darker than any dye.

lines.zh: 再挨一下，我就顶不住了。
lines.en: One more hit and I cannot hold.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音像羊又不像。
lines.en: I cried out, sounding like a goat and not.

lines.zh: 伤口在侧腹，深呼吸都难受。
lines.en: The wound is in my flank; even breathing hurts.

lines.zh: 铃招来了更多，我该跑了。
lines.en: The bell brought more of them; I should run.

lines.zh: 金苹果，我只认这一样。
lines.en: A golden apple: that alone I answer to.

lines.zh: 你把染料举高，我就踮起蹄。
lines.en: Lift the dye higher and I rise on my hooves.

lines.zh: 燧石敲一下，我耳朵就竖起来。
lines.en: One strike of flint and my ears stand up.

lines.zh: 那枚眼在发亮，我忍不住靠近。
lines.en: That eye glows and I cannot help drawing near.

lines.zh: 别拿草糊弄我，我要的是金苹果。
lines.en: Do not fob me off with grass; I want the golden apple.

lines.zh: 四分之一的苹果也够我挪步。
lines.en: Even a quarter apple is enough to move my feet.

lines.zh: 你晃黑染料，我就忘了矜持。
lines.en: Wave that black dye and I forget all restraint.

lines.zh: 我在闻你手上有没有苹果皮。
lines.en: I am sniffing your hands for apple peel.

lines.zh: 铃响了，是因为我走得太急。
lines.en: The bell rings because I hurried too much.

lines.zh: 只要凑齐三样，我立刻跟你走。
lines.en: Gather all three and I follow you at once.

lines.zh: 我的角顶到你，是没算好距离。
lines.en: My horns bumped you; I misjudged the distance.

lines.zh: 别从后面推，我蹄子站不稳。
lines.en: Do not push from behind; my hooves cannot hold.

lines.zh: 撞上时铃铛响了一路。
lines.en: The bell rang all the way through our collision.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，毛蹭过你的腿。
lines.en: I turn aside, my coat brushing against your leg.

lines.zh: 两只山羊挤一条路，总有一个退。
lines.en: Two goats on one path; one must yield.

lines.zh: 我屁股一歪，差点坐进泥里。
lines.en: I tipped sideways and nearly sat in the mud.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的蹄印了，不过没关系。
lines.en: You stepped on my hoofprint; no matter.

lines.zh: 撞疼你了吗，我这对角很硬。
lines.en: Did I hurt you? These horns are hard.

lines.zh: 我低头让路，角尖差点划到你。
lines.en: I lower my head to pass and my horn nearly grazes you.

lines.zh: 这具身体轻，撞一下像撞风。
lines.en: This body is light; I bump like a gust of wind.

lines.zh: 我不生育，我只是从别处分出的一半。
lines.en: I do not breed; I am a half split from another.

lines.zh: 金苹果造就了我，不是另一只羊。
lines.en: A golden apple made me, not another goat.

lines.zh: 想要第二只，就再喂一个苹果。
lines.en: Want a second one? Feed another apple.

lines.zh: 我们这一族，靠分而不是靠生。
lines.en: Our kind grows by splitting, not by birth.

lines.zh: 莎布·尼古拉丝子嗣无数，我不算。
lines.en: Shub-Niggurath has countless young; I am not one.

lines.zh: 两对角碰在一起，也只是打招呼。
lines.en: Two pairs of horns touching is only a greeting.

lines.zh: 我没有伴侣，只有主人和祭礼。
lines.en: I have no mate, only a master and a rite.

lines.zh: 奇美拉是我母亲，也是我原来的全部。
lines.en: The chimera is my mother and was once my whole self.

lines.zh: 分出去的那半只，现在在哪呢。
lines.en: Where is that other half that split away?

lines.zh: 森林里没有母羊愿意理我。
lines.en: No ewe in this forest will look at me.

lines.zh: 我叼起黑染料，嘴里的味道发苦。
lines.en: I pick up black dye and it tastes bitter.

lines.zh: 燧石太滑，我用舌头卷了两次。
lines.en: The flint is slick; I curl my tongue twice.

lines.zh: 末影之眼我不敢咬，怕它碎。
lines.en: I dare not bite the ender eye; it might shatter.

lines.zh: 蹄子夹不住东西，只能用嘴。
lines.en: Hooves cannot grip, so I must use my mouth.

lines.zh: 这枚苹果我留着，谁也不给。
lines.en: I keep this apple and give it to no one.

lines.zh: 地上的东西我闻一闻，再决定叼不叼。
lines.en: I sniff what lies there, then decide whether to carry it.

lines.zh: 我把染料藏在铃铛下面。
lines.en: I hide the dye beneath my bell.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满东西，铃就响得闷。
lines.en: With my mouth full, the bell sounds muffled.

lines.zh: 你要的那三样，我都替你收着。
lines.en: The three things you need, I keep them all.

lines.zh: 捡起来容易，放下得低头。
lines.en: Picking up is easy; letting go takes a bow.

lines.zh: 有人朝主人举起了刀。
lines.en: Someone has raised a blade at my master.

lines.zh: 铃还没响，我已经压低身子。
lines.en: The bell has not rung, yet I am already crouched.

lines.zh: 那东西靠近祭坛，我不能再等。
lines.en: That thing nears the altar; I can wait no longer.

lines.zh: 我这两只角，就是为撞人长的。
lines.en: These two horns grew for ramming.

lines.zh: 它动了，我的蹄先踏出半步。
lines.en: It moved, and my hoof stepped out first.

lines.zh: 主人退后，我就往前顶。
lines.en: My master steps back, so I push forward.

lines.zh: 森林里闯进陌生的脚步。
lines.en: Strange footsteps have broken into the forest.

lines.zh: 我盯住它的手，那里有武器。
lines.en: I fix on its hands, where the weapon is.

lines.zh: 我不算强壮，但顶一下够它受的。
lines.en: I am not strong, but one ram will sting.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我一跃就能到。
lines.en: At this distance, one leap will reach it.

lines.zh: 铃在颈上发烫，像在催我。
lines.en: The bell burns on my neck as if urging me.

lines.zh: 它抢了金苹果，这就没得谈了。
lines.en: It took the golden apple; there is nothing to discuss.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛横着看它，慢慢转过去。
lines.en: My flat pupils turn toward it, slowly.

lines.zh: 主人一句话，我便认下这个敌人。
lines.en: One word from my master and I accept this enemy.

lines.zh: 我低着头，把角对准它的腰。
lines.en: Head low, I aim my horns at its waist.

lines.zh: 绕半圈，找它没护住的那侧。
lines.en: Half a circle to find its unguarded side.

lines.zh: 蹄子刨了两下土，是起跑的准备。
lines.en: Two pawing kicks in the dirt, my running start.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的铃就轻响。
lines.en: It shifts, and my bell gives a light ring.

lines.zh: 我憋着不叫，喉头一直在抖。
lines.en: I keep my bleat in, though my throat keeps shaking.

lines.zh: 再退一步，我就撞上去了。
lines.en: One more step back and I charge.

lines.zh: 它的影子被树影切碎，我看不清。
lines.en: Tree shadows cut up its outline and I cannot see clearly.

lines.zh: 我闻得到它身上的铁锈味。
lines.en: I smell the rust of iron on it.

lines.zh: 角尖对着它的膝盖，那里最软。
lines.en: My horn tips point at its knees, the softest part.

lines.zh: 我在数它呼吸的间隔。
lines.en: I am counting the gaps between its breaths.

lines.zh: 林子太密，我得挑开阔处冲。
lines.en: The woods are dense; I need open ground to charge.

lines.zh: 它回头看了一眼，机会来了。
lines.en: It glanced back, and my chance arrived.

lines.zh: 我把后蹄压进泥里，蓄着劲。
lines.en: I plant my rear hooves in mud and gather strength.

lines.zh: 铃晃了一下，我没有出声。
lines.en: The bell swayed once and I made no sound.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，铃一声不响。
lines.en: I lower my head, and the bell stays silent.

lines.zh: 我整只撞过去，角先到。
lines.en: I ram with my whole body, horns first.

lines.zh: 这一顶撞在它肋骨上，很实。
lines.en: This blow lands solidly on its ribs.

lines.zh: 蹄子跟着踩下去，泥土飞起来。
lines.en: My hooves follow down and mud sprays up.

lines.zh: 铃炸响，我把头往上一掀。
lines.en: The bell blares as I jerk my head upward.

lines.zh: 撞完我退开两步，重新压低。
lines.en: After ramming I back off two steps and crouch again.

lines.zh: 角卡住了，我甩头才拔出来。
lines.en: My horns stuck; I had to shake them free.

lines.zh: 它抓我的背，我用后蹄踢。
lines.en: It claws my back, so I kick with my rear hooves.

lines.zh: 这一下不算狠，但够它踉跄。
lines.en: Not a brutal hit, but enough to make it stumble.

lines.zh: 我撞偏了，角擦过它的胳膊。
lines.en: I missed clean; my horn scraped its arm.

lines.zh: 血味一出来，我就更用力。
lines.en: Once blood smells, I push harder still.

lines.zh: 我喘着气，还是再顶一次。
lines.en: Panting hard, I ram one more time.

lines.zh: 铃响成一片，敌人会更靠近。
lines.en: The bell rings wildly, and enemies will come closer.

lines.zh: 奇美拉咽下金苹果，我从它体内分出。
lines.en: The chimera swallowed the apple and I split from it.

lines.zh: 分裂那刻，我落地就站住了。
lines.en: The moment I split, I landed on steady hooves.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先看到自己的两只蹄。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and first saw my own hooves.

lines.zh: 一半留在原来的身体里，一半是我。
lines.en: Half stayed in that body; half became me.

lines.zh: 被召唤出来时，颈上还没有铃。
lines.en: When I was summoned, no bell hung on my neck.

lines.zh: 我从金苹果的光里走出来。
lines.en: I walked out of the golden apple's glow.

lines.zh: 第一口呼吸，是森林的湿气。
lines.en: My first breath was damp forest air.

lines.zh: 升级那天，主人给我系上了铃。
lines.en: On the day I was upgraded, my master tied on the bell.

lines.zh: 我落地时，草被压出一个坑。
lines.en: When I landed, the grass held a dent.

lines.zh: 召唤阵的边还没熄灭，我已站好。
lines.en: The circle still glowed when I was already standing.

lines.zh: 我生来就带着一半的记忆。
lines.en: I was born carrying half of someone's memories.

lines.zh: 他们叫我山羊，其实我更像影子。
lines.en: They call me a goat, but I am more a shadow.

lines.zh: 初生的蹄子软，我走了三步才稳。
lines.en: New hooves are soft; three steps steadied me.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，铃烫得慌。
lines.en: Fire singes my coat and the bell is burning hot.

lines.zh: 落地时我折了前蹄，站不直。
lines.en: I landed badly and my foreleg will not straighten.

lines.zh: 水没到脖子，铃沉得往下坠。
lines.en: Water reaches my neck and the bell drags me down.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀起来，角磕在树上。
lines.en: The blast throws me and my horns crack a tree.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的肩，铃跟着一颤。
lines.en: The arrow passes my shoulder and the bell shivers.

lines.zh: 药水一淋，我的蹄印开始发白。
lines.en: Potion splashes me and my hoofprints turn pale.

lines.zh: 金苹果早吃完了，我饿得发昏。
lines.en: The golden apple is long gone and hunger blurs me.

lines.zh: 雷落在我角上，整只羊亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my horns and my whole body glows.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有树，也没有落脚的地。
lines.en: The void has no trees and nothing to stand on.
